jobs.title: Brand Executive
jobs.description: Are you someone who is strategic, analytical, and passionate about building strong brands? If so, we are looking for you! PT Cantik Alami Sehat is continuously growing, and we are looking for a Brand Executive who is ready to support brand management and marketing activities. Whether you already have experience in brand management within the FMCG industry or are looking to further develop your career in a dynamic industry, what matters most to us is your strategic thinking, attention to detail, analytical ability, and willingness to contribute to the growth of our brands. As a Brand Executive, you will play an important role in supporting brand management, marketing campaigns, and strategic initiatives. You will work closely with various departments, including Design, Social Media, Ecommerce, KOL, Affiliate, and Sales teams, to ensure that brand strategies and marketing activities are carried out effectively, consistently, and in line with the company's objectives. You will have the opportunity to develop your competencies in brand management and marketing, work alongside cross-functional teams, and contribute to various initiatives aimed at strengthening brand presence, improving campaign effectiveness, and supporting business growth. Here are the qualifications you must have: Experience in brand management, preferably within the FMCG industry or beauty Companies Strong understanding of market research and consumer insights. Strong strategic communication skills. Ability to develop SOPs, campaign briefs, marketing guidelines, and other structured documentation. Strong mathematical and data analysis skills. Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills. What will you do? Assist in planning and executing branding and marketing campaigns Develop campaign briefs, marketing guidelines, SOPs, and operational protocols for internal teams and external partners Translate brand and campaign ideas into clear, structured, and actionable documentation Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Design, Social Media, Ecommerce, KOL, Affiliate, and Sales teams Ensure brand consistency across online and offline channels Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and consumer trend monitoring Support product launches, promotional activations, and seasonal campaigns Analyze campaign performance, sales data, and marketing effectiveness Prepare campaign reports, presentations, and strategic recommendations Support budgeting, target tracking, and performance evaluation

About the role

This role involves developing and executing risk-based internal audit plans covering financial, operational, compliance, and business processes across Head Office and mining site operations. You will conduct comprehensive audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and compliance with company policies and applicable regulations.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute risk-based internal audit plans covering financial, operational, compliance, and business processes across Head Office and mining site operations

  • Conduct comprehensive audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and compliance with company policies and applicable regulations

  • Review and test financial transactions, accounting records, procurement activities, inventory, payroll, budgeting, cost control, and other key business processes

  • Conduct operational audits across mining activities to assess compliance with SOPs, policies, work procedures, and established internal controls

  • Identify control weaknesses, process inefficiencies, potential fraud, financial irregularities, and other risks that may impact the company's operations and financial performance

  • Prepare detailed audit working papers, audit findings, risk assessments, and audit reports with clear and practical recommendations for management

  • Follow up on audit findings and monitor the implementation of corrective and preventive actions to ensure agreed recommendations are properly implemented

  • Conduct special audits or investigations as requested by management, including reviews of suspected irregularities, policy violations, or potential fraud

  • Lead and supervise audit assignments, including planning audit activities, allocating tasks, reviewing audit work, and ensuring audit deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule

  • Conduct field audits and site visits to mining operations to verify the implementation of controls and procedures in actual operational conditions

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, Business Administration, Law, or a closely related discipline

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in internal audit, external audit, risk management, compliance, or related functions (Prefer mining experienced), with relevant supervisory experience

  • Proven experience conducting financial, operational, compliance, and process audits, preferably within the mining, nickel, coal, resources, or heavy industrial sectors

  • Strong knowledge of internal control, risk management, audit methodology, corporate governance, and compliance principles

  • Strong understanding of financial and business processes, including accounting, procurement, budgeting, inventory, payroll, cost control, logistics, and supply chain

  • Ability to independently perform risk assessment, audit planning, audit testing, root cause analysis, and evaluation of internal controls

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to identify irregularities, control weaknesses, inefficiencies, potential fraud, and compliance risks

  • Excellent ability to prepare audit reports, working papers, audit findings, and management recommendations in a clear and structured manner

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, with knowledge of audit software or data analytics tools considered an advantage

  • Good command of Bahasa Indonesia and English, both written and verbal

jobs.title: Sales Marketing
jobs.description: Assalammu'alaikum PT. ZHAFIRAH MITRA MADINA adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang jasa tour and travel Haji dan Umroh. Dengan semangat inovasi dan pelayanan terbaik, kami terus mencari tenaga profesional yang berdedikasi tinggi untuk mengembangkan usaha kami. Saat ini, kami sedang membuka lowongan pekerjaan untuk posisi Sales Executive dan Sales Representative. Keberhasilan bisnis kami bergantung pada dedikasi dan komitmen Anda dalam melayani pelanggan dengan penuh perhatian dan membangun hubungan bisnis yang kuat. Dalam posisi Sales Executive dan Sales Representative, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk mendukung penjualan produk kami melalui berbagai kanal. Beberapa tugas utama yang akan Anda jalani meliputi: - Meningkatkan penjualan produk melalui strategi pemasaran dan promosi yang efektif. - Mengelola relasi dengan pelanggan dan menjaga hubungan yang baik untuk memastikan kepuasan pelanggan. - Melakukan riset pasar untuk memahami kebutuhan pelanggan dan menyesuaikan strategi penjualan. - Menyusun laporan penjualan secara berkala dan memberikan umpan balik kepada tim manajemen. - Mendukung pengembangan produk dan layanan dengan memberikan umpan balik dari pelanggan. Kualifikasi untuk posisi Sales Executive dan Sales Representative di PT. ZHAFIRAH MITRA MADINA adalah sebagai berikut: - Pendidikan minimal Sederajat/Diploma. - Pengalaman kerja antara 1 hingga 3 tahun dalam bidang penjualan atau layanan pelanggan. - Kemampuan dalam bidang Customer Service, Sales Strategy, Sales and Marketing, Communication Skills, dan Sales Management. - Berkomunikasi dengan baik dan mampu bekerja dalam tim. - Kesiapan untuk bekerja dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan hasil orientasional. - Kesiapan dalam mengejar Target Customer. PT. ZHAFIRAH MITRA MADINA berusaha memberikan kesempatan bagi para kandidat yang memiliki potensi dan ambisi untuk sukses dan berkembang di dalam perusahaan kami. Kami percaya bahwa setiap individu memiliki peran penting dalam pencapaian kesuksesan bersama. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami dan mulailah karier yang menjanjikan di bidang sales executive dengan komisi hingga RP. 30.000.000 per bulan, dapatkan juga kesempatan untuk Haji dan Umroh bersama kami.

jobs.title: Admin Produksi
jobs.description: About the role This role involves managing production data and reporting functions, including data entry, validation, monitoring, and coordination across production departments. Melakukan monitoring dan rekapitulasi hasil produksi, target, serta pencapaian produksi. Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen dan administrasi produksi. Berkoordinasi dengan Leader Produksi, PPIC, QC, dan departemen terkait. Membantu menyiapkan data dan laporan yang dibutuhkan untuk evaluasi produksi. Qualifications Minimal SMA/SMK sederajat, diutamakan D3/S1. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel, terutama Pivot Table. Teliti, cepat, dan memiliki perhatian tinggi terhadap detail. Mampu mengolah dan menganalisis data sederhana. Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi yang baik. Mampu bekerja dengan target dan deadline. Komunikatif dan mampu bekerja sama dengan tim. Pengalaman sebagai Admin Produksi menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: Account Payable and General Cashier (AP/GC)
jobs.description: Essential Functions: Process supplier invoices, cheque requests and expense claims into the accounts payable system on a timely basis. Liaise with external suppliers and internal claimants to achieve compliance with system, procedures and processes. Follow-up and clear on a timely basis, outstanding supplier invoices awaiting authorization. Process cheque runs on a timely basis to ensure creditors are paid in accordance with credit terms and to take advantage of available discounts in line with company. Process employee expense claims for payment within 7 bussiness days of receipt of claim. Assist receiving clerk and stores with maintenance and operations of the accounts payable system with regard to Food and Beverage. Organize all foreign drafts and telegraphic transfers where required. Maintain manual cheque e-banking batch log at all times and present to Financial Controller. Maintain adequate supply of cheques book. Ensure all supplier invoice are stamped “paid” after payment has been processed.

Essential Functions:

  1. Process supplier invoices, cheque requests and expense claims into the accounts payable system on a timely basis.

  2. Liaise with external suppliers and internal claimants to achieve compliance with system, procedures and processes.

  9. Maintain adequate supply of cheques book.

  10. Ensure all supplier invoice are stamped “paid” after payment has been processed.

jobs.title: Junior Barista
jobs.description: Deskripsi pekerjaan Tanggung Jawab Utama Menyiapkan dan menyajikan berbagai minuman kopi, teh, dan minuman khusus sesuai standar kualitas dan resep yang telah ditetapkan oleh perusahaan. Mengoperasikan mesin espresso, grinder, dan peralatan barista lainnya dengan benar dan menjaganya dalam kondisi bersih serta optimal. Memberikan layanan pelanggan yang ramah dan profesional, mendengarkan pesanan dengan teliti dan merekomendasikan menu sesuai preferensi pelanggan. Memastikan area kerja bar tetap rapi, higienis, dan terorganisir setiap saat selama shift. Berkolaborasi dengan rekan kerja untuk memastikan operasional bar berjalan lancar dan efisien, terutama selama jam-jam sibuk. Menangani transaksi pembayaran dengan akurat dan profesional. Mempelajari dan menerapkan teknik barista terbaru serta terus meningkatkan keterampilan pembuatan minuman. Mematuhi prosedur keselamatan dan kebersihan yang berlaku di industri hospitality. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara, dengan preferensi pada lulusan bidang perhotelan atau kuliner. Pengalaman 0-1 tahun di bidang barista, kafe, atau layanan minuman adalah nilai tambah. Pemahaman dasar tentang berbagai jenis kopi, biji kopi, dan teknik penyeduhan. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan minimal bahasa Inggris dasar untuk melayani tamu internasional. Keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat dengan kemampuan memberikan layanan pelanggan yang ramah dan profesional. Perhatian terhadap detail dan standar kebersihan yang tinggi. Kemampuan bekerja dalam tim yang solid dan responsif terhadap instruksi. Bersedia bekerja dengan jadwal yang fleksibel, termasuk shift pagi, siang, dan malam. Sertifikasi barista dari lembaga terkemuka merupakan keuntungan tambahan namun tidak wajib.

Job Overview:

Assist in carrying out financing, risk mitigation and insurance business activities, including business planning, execution, and development, to achieve LPEI’s business targets.


Job Descriptions:

  1. Process administration related to business proposal submissions.

  2. Assist in collecting financial and other required information on (prospective) customers.

  3. Maintain good relationships with customers.

  4. Input rating data for (prospective) customers.

  5. Support RM in monitoring customer business activities, fulfillment of obligations and financing requirements, including taking preventive actions in case of declining business performance.

  6. Assist RM in preparing financing collectability assessments and objective evidence analyses, including individual CKPN calculations and maintaining financing collectability with related units.

  7. Carry out departmental administrative activities in accordance with applicable internal and external regulations.

  8. Assist in activities related to the use/utilization of customer facilities.

  9. Ensure achievement of individual targets.

  10. Carry out all operational activities in accordance with applicable good corporate governance principles.

  11. Assist in fulfilling audit follow-up actions.

  12. Perform other tasks as required by the institution and/or instructions from superiors.


Job Requirements:

  • Minimum graduate from any reputable university. Post-graduation will be an added advantage

  • At least 2 years of experience in banking and/or financial institutions

  • Very good analysis, interpersonal, and communication skills to work with the team and different stakeholders

  • Hold Risk Management Certification Level 1 (will be an added advantage)

jobs.title: Content Creator Specialist
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities: - Menyusun strategi konten end-to-end dan mengelola content calendar bulanan untuk TikTok, Instagram Reels, dan platform media sosial lainnya. - Menjadi talent utama di depan kamera yang dapat merepresentasikan target audience Momelca secara autentik, menarik, dan percaya diri. - Mampu mengemas video yang menunjukkan Unique Selling Proposition (USP) atau keunggulan produk Momelca (seperti cuttingan yang pas, anti-kusut, dll.) menjadi video visual yang jelas, edukatif, namun tetap estetis dan menjual. - Menulis naskah (scripting), mengarahkan visual, dan memproduksi video hiburan bernuansa soft selling yang halus namun efektif mendorong penjualan. - Aktif memantau tren fashion, audio viral, serta budaya terkini untuk diadaptasi menjadi ide konten yang fresh. - Membuat copywriting/caption, teks video, dan Call to Action (CTA) yang kuat untuk memicu interaksi engagement audiens. - Berkoordinasi dengan tim Marketing, Desain, dan Gudang terkait peluncuran produk baru, highlighting feature, dan ketersediaan stok. - Menganalisis metrik performa video (reach, engagement, conversion) dan reporting sebagai evaluasi berkala kepada BOD untuk perbaikan strategi. Requirements: - Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Content Creator, Video Creator, atau Copywriter (diutamakan berpengalaman di industri fashion, lifestyle, atau e-commerce). - Background studi S1 di Pemasaran, Komunikasi, DKV, Produksi Media, atau bidang terkait (pengalaman praktis dan portofolio kuat lebih diutamakan). - Percaya diri, memiliki ekspresi yang natural, dan berpengalaman menjadi on-camera talent. - Mahir menggunakan aplikasi editing video di smartphone maupun laptop (CapCut, Premiere Pro, InShot, dll.). - Menguasai alat desain dasar (Canva/Photoshop) untuk kebutuhan materi promosi ringan. - Memahami dasar-dasar pengambilan gambar (lighting, sudut kamera, dan mikrofon). - Memiliki portofolio yang menampilkan karya video pendek (TikTok/Reels), naskah konten, serta pencapaian performa video yang pernah dibuat (WAJIB) . - Memiliki storytelling yang kuat, pemahaman selera humor yang relevan dengan anak kantor, adaptif, terbiasa dengan deadline, dan proaktif.

Lead, motivate, and develop the Affiliate team. Requirements Minimum 3 years of proven experience in Affiliate Marketing or a related role. Extensive network and database of affiliates. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field. Proven experience managing a diverse range of affiliates or talents, preferably in the beauty industry. Willing to work full-time onsite (WFO) at Summarecon Bekasi.

jobs.title: Staff Accounting & Pajak (Marketplace)
jobs.description: Posisi Staff Accounting & Pajak (Marketplace) bertanggung jawab dalam mengelola pencatatan transaksi keuangan, rekonsiliasi penjualan marketplace, administrasi perpajakan, serta memastikan seluruh proses berjalan sesuai dengan standar akuntansi dan peraturan perpajakan yang berlaku. Melakukan rekonsiliasi penjualan dan pembayaran dari marketplace (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada, dan platform lainnya). Membantu penyusunan jurnal, laporan keuangan bulanan, dan proses closing. Menghitung, menyetor, dan membantu pelaporan pajak perusahaan (PPN, PPh 21, PPh 23, dan pajak lainnya). Mengelola administrasi perpajakan, termasuk e-Faktur, e-Bupot, Coretax, dan DJP Online. Membuat, memeriksa, dan mengelola dokumen Bukti Potong (Bupot) sesuai ketentuan perpajakan. Memastikan seluruh transaksi terdokumentasi dengan baik sesuai standar akuntansi dan peraturan perpajakan. Kualifikasi : usia maksimal 35 tahun. Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi atau Perpajakan . Fresh Graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memahami dasar-dasar akuntansi dan perpajakan Indonesia. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Table, IF, SUMIFS menjadi nilai tambah). Operate and manage technical equipment for hybrid events (e.g., vMix, lighting systems, streaming setups, and audio equipment), ensuring full technical readiness before and during practical lectures and events. Assist lecturers during instructional sessions, including supporting students in using relevant software and tools for event management preparation. Facilitate connections between students and industry professionals for case studies, mentorship, and event collaborations. Manage and maintain green screen operations for virtual and multimedia productions. Serve as Front of House (FOH) personnel for Nusantara Hall.

jobs.title: Customer Service
jobs.description: About the Role: We are looking for a dedicated and proactive Customer Service professional to join our team. As the main point of contact for customers across various platforms, you will handle inquiries, resolve complaints, and process orders to ensure a smooth and positive customer experience. You will work closely with internal teams to address order and shipping issues, playing a key role in maintaining customer satisfaction and loyalty. By delivering timely, accurate information about our products and services, you will represent the face of our company and contribute to its success. Responsibilities: Respond to customer inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle product issues, returns, and exchanges. Manage and track orders, ensuring timely delivery. Collaborate with the logistics team to resolve shipping issues. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions. Monitor and respond to customer reviews and feedback. Provide product and policy information. Continuously improve service procedures based on feedback.

jobs.title: Branch Manager Surabaya
jobs.description: Memimpin dan mengelola tim (Leader dan teknisi/sales) di areanya untuk memastikan penyelesaian tiket pekerjaan operasional aplikasi Payment dan target penjualan produk aplikasi PPOB / POS sesuai kebijakan perusahaan. Melakukan monitoring performa harian, baik terkait penyelesaian tiket pekerjaan operasional maupun pencapaian penjualan. Menetapkan target harian secara objektif dan terukur untuk tim teknisi / sales Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pemenuhan Service Level Agreement (SLA) tiket pekerjaan opersional Melakukan pemantauan dan eskalasi terhadap Tiket Urgent agar terselesaikan tepat waktu. Menganalisis dan melakukan mapping/remapping populasi teknisi secara merata, serta proaktif mengajukan penambahan teknisi jika area tersebut sudah overload. Membuka peluang bisnis baru di areanya melalui penawaran strategis produk POSe (PPOB / POS). Menjaga relasi dengan merchant -merchant prioritas pengguna Produk POSe dan engagement dengan Kantor Wilayah/Cabang Klien. jobs.title: HubSpot Developer and API & AI Automation Contractor
jobs.description: KPS is seeking an experienced, remote HubSpot Developer / API & AI Automation Contractor to work directly with our U.S.-based team on the development, customization, integration, and automation of our business systems. Pay- $2,000/month This is a hands-on technical role beyond standard HubSpot administration. Looking for a developer who can customize HubSpot CRM and CMS, build API integrations between software platforms, develop advanced workflows and automations, support marketing campaigns, and build AI-powered tools and bots that can extract, organize, analyze, and act on business data. The ideal candidate is someone who can understand a business process, identify how technology can improve it, and then design and build the solution . HubSpot CRM Development & Customization Customize HubSpot CRM for our sales, estimating, customer service, operations, and marketing teams. Create and manage: Custom properties/objects Deal pipelines/stages Contact and company records Associations between records Lead routing, Task automation, Sales/approval sequences Build automated actions based on deal stage changes, customer activity, dates, values, or other business conditions. Create workflows that automatically update records, assign tasks, notify employees, generate follow-up actions, and move information between departments. Improve CRM data structure, consistency, and usability. Assist with HubSpot reporting, dashboards, attribution, and management reporting. HubSpot CMS & Website Development Customize/maintain existing previously built HubSpot CMS websites and landing pages. Build/modify: Website templates Landing pages Forms Modules Dynamic content Calls-to-action Customer-facing forms and portals Connect website activity and form submissions directly into CRM processes and automated workflows. Support SEO, tracking, conversion optimization, and website analytics. API Development & Software Integrations Working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth, and API authentication. Connecting HubSpot with ERP, accounting, estimating, project management, customer service, communication, marketing, and other software platforms. Building custom middleware or integration applications when native integrations are not available. Creating two-way data synchronization between systems. Mapping data fields between different applications. Automating the transfer of contacts, companies, deals, projects, pricing, products, documents, and other business information. Troubleshooting API errors, failed synchronization, authentication issues, and data conflicts. Creating documentation for integrations and workflows. AI Bots, Data Extraction & Business Automation Extract information from documents, PDFs, emails, websites, CRM records, and other data sources. Compare information between systems. Populate CRM fields automatically. Create tasks or workflows based on extracted information. Analyze customer or project information. Generate responses, summaries, reports, or recommendations. Trigger HubSpot workflows or API actions based on AI analysis. Experience working with OpenAI APIs, AI agents, large language models, vector databases, OCR/document processing, or similar AI technologies is highly desirable. Assist with Marketing automation, Deal and sales automation, Cross-Platform Automation, project collaboration, and more. Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Technical Lead
jobs.description: Pengembangan Kode: Menulis kode aplikasi yang efisien, rapi, dan mudah dikelola sesuai dengan standar perusahaan (keamanan dan performa). Jaminan Kualitas: Memastikan setiap fungsi berjalan lancar tanpa bug dan memenuhi kriteria yang ditentukan. Code Review & Mentoring: Memeriksa kode rekan tim, serta membimbing anggota tim yang lebih junior terkait best practice dan standar penulisan kode. Kolaborasi Tim: Bekerja sama dengan System Analyst, tim QC, BA, dan UI/UX untuk memastikan proyek selesai tepat waktu. Inovasi: Mengimplementasikan perangkat berbasis AI untuk mempercepat proses pengembangan (SDLC). Pemeliharaan: Melakukan pembaruan (patching), memperbaiki bug, dan mendokumentasikan panduan penggunaan aplikasi. Dukungan Teknis: Jika diperlukan, membantu tim bisnis dalam proses Proof of Concept (POC) atau uji coba aplikasi.

jobs.title: Account Manager B2B
jobs.description: Job Description Mencari dan menjalin kerja sama dengan mitra RT/RW Net (subnet) sebagai partner bisnis perusahaan di wilayah operasional perusahaan. Melakukan pendekatan, negosiasi, serta presentasi penawaran kerjasama kepada calon mitra. Mengembangkan jaringan dan membuka peluang kerja sama baru untuk meningkatkan pertumbuhan bisnis perusahaan. Menjalin dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan seluruh mitra RT/RW Net untuk memastikan kepuasan, keberlangsungan kerjasama, serta pengembangan kemitraan. Mengidentifikasi kebutuhan mitra serta memberikan solusi yang sesuai dengan layanan perusahaan. Memantau perkembangan kerjasama dengan setiap mitra, melakukan kunjungan secara berkala, serta mengidentifikasi peluang pengembangan kemitraan Berkoordinasi dengan tim internal (operasional, teknis, dan terkait) untuk memastikan implementasi dan pelayanan kepada mitra berjalan optimal. Membuat laporan aktivitas penjualan, pipeline, dan perkembangan kerja sama secara berkala. Kualifikasi Minimal pendidikan D3/S1 dari semua jurusan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Sales B2B, Account Manager, Business Development, Channel Partnership, atau posisi sejenis (pengalaman di industri ISP/Telekomunikasi menjadi nilai tambah). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan relationship management yang baik. Berorientasi pada target dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim. Memiliki kemampuan membangun relasi bisnis dengan berbagai stakeholder. Memiliki networking yang luas di komunitas RT/RW Net serta memahami dunia ISP menjadi nilai plus. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas di wilayah operasional perusahaan Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office atau Google Workspace.

jobs.title: ISP Operations Internship
jobs.description: ISP Operations Internship Bertugas memberikan dukungan administratif, dokumentasi, dan pengembangan materi operasional kepada tim Strategic Partner Commercial. Posisi ini berperan dalam membantu penyusunan standar kerja, dokumentasi proses bisnis, serta kebutuhan koordinasi operasional sehingga aktivitas divisi dapat berjalan lebih efektif dan terdokumentasi dengan baik. Job Description Membantu menyusun, memperbarui, dan mengelola panduan kerja (SOP/Work Instruction/Guidebook) sesuai kebutuhan operasional divisi. Membantu menyusun materi presentasi, pelatihan, maupun kebutuhan komunikasi internal. Mendukung penyusunan dokumentasi operasional, termasuk pengarsipan digital dan standardisasi dokumen. Memberikan dukungan teknis dasar terkait penggunaan dokumen, template, maupun tools operasional yang digunakan oleh tim. Memberikan dukungan administratif kepada tim Strategic Partner Commercial sesuai kebutuhan operasional yang relevan. Mendukung persiapan dan pelaksanaan kegiatan operasional divisi, seperti pelatihan, sosialisasi, meeting, maupun kegiatan koordinasi lainnya. Kualifikasi Mahasiswa semester akhir atau Fresh Graduate D3/S1 semua jurusan (diutamakan Teknik/Telekomunikasi/Sistem Informasi/Jurusan yang relevan). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Memiliki rasa ingin tahu yang tinggi, proaktif, serta memiliki kemauan belajar terhadap proses bisnis dan operasional perusahaan. Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office dan Google Workspace. Memiliki kemampuan menyusun dokumen, presentasi, atau laporan secara rapi dan sistematis. Memiliki pengetahuan atau pengalaman di industri Telekomunikasi, Internet Service Provider (ISP), atau teknologi informasi menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: PPIC & Supply Chain Staff (FnB)
jobs.description: Job descriptions : Production & Demand Planning : Membuat production planning berdasarkan forecast penjualan, historical sales, dan kebutuhan outlet. Inventory Control : Menentukan minimum stock, maximum stock, dan reorder point. Material Requirement Planning : Membuat Material Requirement Planning (MRP) berdasarkan forecast dan production plan. Coordination with Purchasing Food Cost & Waste Control : Mengidentifikasi potensi variance antara theoretical usage dan actual usage. Reporting & Analysis : Inventory Report; Stock Movement Report; Stock Aging Report; Material Requirement Report; Production Planning Report, etc Coordination with Outlet & Operations : Berkoordinasi dengan Outlet Manager/Operations mengenai forecast dan kebutuhan bahan. Qualifications: Minimum D3/S1 in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Management, Logistics, Accounting, or related field. 1–2 years of experience in PPIC, Inventory Control, Warehouse, Purchasing, or Supply Chain; F&B experience is preferred. Strong understanding of inventory management, forecasting, material planning, FIFO/FEFO, and stock control. Familiar with BOM/recipe, food cost, material variance, yield, and waste monitoring. Proficient in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets and data analysis. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills. Detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and able to work in a fast-paced F&B environment. Experience handling central kitchen and/or multi-outlet operations is an advantage.
jobs.raw:

jobs.title: Direct Sales Agent (Malang)
jobs.description: PT XLSMART Telecom Sejahtera Tbk adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk menghubungkan setiap warga Indonesia agar hidupnya lebih baik. Sebagai salah satu pemain terkuat di industri telekomunikasi Indonesia, kami melebihi koneksi—kami membangun jembatan yang bermakna yang memperkuat kehidupan, memperkuat komunitas, dan mendorong bangsa untuk maju bersama. XLSMART dikenal sebagai pemimpin industri dalam kredibilitas, kepercayaan, dan inovasi, serta terus menetapkan standar dalam memberikan solusi digital yang andal dan mutakhir sesuai dengan kebutuhan stakeholder. Yang membedakan kami sebagai pemimpin inovasi adalah pendekatan berbasis manusia. Di inti kesuksesan luar biasa kami adalah budaya praktis dan visioner yang disebut prinsip nilai i-CARE: Integritas, Pelanggan di Hati, Bertindak Seperti Pemilik, Bangkit Bersama, Menikmati Setiap Langkah. Nilai-nilai ini adalah prinsip yang telah membentuk segala sesuatu yang kami lakukan dan telah menjadi kebiasaan sehari-hari. Kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja inovatif, inklusif, dan kolaboratif di mana bakat berkembang, ide berkembang, dan memberikan peluang karier dengan rasa syukur dan kebahagiaan. XLSMART bukan hanya tempat kerja yang hebat—ini adalah tempat terbaik untuk berkembang menjadi versi terbaik dari individu yang luar biasa. Jangan pernah mengatakan tidak untuk berkembang bersama XLSMART, bersama kita akan menjalani perjalanan yang penuh hasil—kamu, aku, dan setiap karyawan, bersatu dalam meredefinisikan masa depan Indonesia. Kualifikasi (Requirements): Wanita atau Pria usia minimal 18 tahun dan maksimal 45 tahun Pendidikan minimal SMA atau sederajat Pengalaman di bidang penjualan langsung Siap bekerja di lapangan Memiliki motor dan SIM C Bersedia bekerja dibawah pihak ketiga Benefit Penghasilan bulanan Insentif penjualan yang menarik Jenjang karir Program pengembangan kompetensi bersertifikasi Tertarik jadi bagian dari perjalanan kami? Apply sekarang, dan menjadi bagian dari XLSMART Warrior!

jobs.title: IT Application Officer
jobs.description: Job Description - Manage and support business applications their lifecycle to ensure system availability, performance, and continuous improvement. - Analyze business requirements and deliver application solutions, enhancements, and system integrations that support business operations. - Provide Level 2 application support by troubleshooting issues, performing root cause analysis, and coordinating with vendors to ensure timely resolution. - Monitor application performance, perform preventive maintenance, and ensure system security, stability, backup, and recovery processes. - Collaborate with business users on requirements gathering, implementation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training, and post-implementation support. - Manage user access, maintain application documentation, and ensure compliance with IT policies, standards, and audit requirements. - Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve business processes and user experience. Requirements - Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Accounting Information System, or a related field. - Minimum 5-8 years of experience in Application Support, Business Applications, ERP, or a similar role, including at least two end-to-end ERP or enterprise system implementations. - Strong knowledge of SDLC, SQL, ERP/business applications, and system integration. - Experience in application troubleshooting, UAT, vendor management, and stakeholder collaboration. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. - ITIL Foundation or other relevant certifications are an advantage.
